title: Subtle changes. Longer review pending.
summary: The new test keeps the drawing close to the previous version. Fine-detail measurements improved in short scenes from episodes 5 and 8, but visible differences remain subtle. The test stays experimental; episode-length validation is pending.
problem: The original DVD picture can look soft. Restoring texture is useful only if faces, outlines and motion still look right. A score can improve even when a person cannot see a worthwhile change.
response: The previous version remains our reference. The new test showed no obvious new distortion in reviewed stills, but has not been adopted.
beforeDetail: Previous version: the reference used before today’s test. This is a crop of Orihime in episode 8, about seven minutes into the episode.
afterDetail: New test: the identical moment and crop. Look at the cheek, eye and hair outlines. They remain very similar; better measurements do not establish a visible improvement.
imageNote: Today’s images come from the completed episode 8 comparison, not the pending full-episode evaluation. Older examples are kept separately in the archive.
stageNote: Step 3 of the four-step review cycle. Short comparisons completed; episode validation pending.
nextStep: Check original timing and distributed image samples after the episode 8 evaluation finishes. Do not adopt the test before review.
